title: Add the published R438 profile and its 132-unit local drop
body:
## Summary
- The profile `{1:1298, 2:1342, 3:79, 4:44, 5:93, 6:11, 7:9}` has 2,876 paid children and rank mass 4,989.
- The change `-9 e7 − 24 e1 − 9 e5` saves `9·7 + 24 + 9·5 = 132`, and `5121 − 132 = 4989`. Nine helper families take the dirty-helper count from 438 to 429.
- Width-8 accounting returns `9 · 8 = 72` rank units per call, so the local drop is not a global saving. The ADD split `5758 + 5619 + 1499 + 347 = 13223` is down 11,025 from 24,248. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/r438-rank-drop/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/r438-rank-drop/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r438-rank-drop`
- [ ] Maintainer replay on canonical main
